#### math-2 — Ordered Olson (MathOlson-2-2)

- **Original target:** Prove ordered Olson EGZ for unrestricted original-order group words, with the prime-dihedral residual as an initial route rather than the full target.
- **Adopted at exact scope:**
  - For every prime `p>=7` and actual `R=p+2`, `F=3p-3` word with nonzero rotations and singleton cyclic gaps, the full-cycle status, complement jets and VALUE, occupied-parity and cyclic-arc selectors, and two-formal-zero-character classification retain their actual values. The `p=7,11` zero-free singleton-gap ambient classes are covered; whole fixed-`R` composition with `TA` remains a separate conditional audit, not full `D14/D22`.
  - For every prime `p>=7` and actual length-`4p-1` word in `D_(2p)`, v224 gives the actual selector indicator, all-count degree bound and exact even-cube point-mass minimum degree, plus stated low/high selectors and the independent `R=p+1` reconstruction. Degree and even-vertex point-mass data alone cannot settle intermediate counts.
- **Candidate/operational boundary:** The original all-finite-group ordered problem is not silently narrowed to the prime-dihedral route. v202 actual-word prerequisite STOP and all nine held-formula/v126/v150 consumers ZERO remain; v254 cadence and v256 old-metadata exposure are permanent. v253 duty is a completed cross-domain composition review, not an Olson advance.
- **Original problem:** **OPEN:** `NR-ACTUAL-WORD-BRIDGE`, intermediate selectors, full `D14/D22` and all-finite-group Olson remain open; `OG/TA/arc` providers remain statement-level.
- **Evidence:** [Parent 1](/Users/jinleic/repos/aifours/institute/runs/three-area-2026-10-23-96h/olson-v224-all-count-status-degree-parity-entire-parent-v1.md) · [Complete row-level evidence and pins](/Users/jinleic/repos/aifours/institute/runs/three-area-2026-10-23-96h/report-ledger-census-precutoff-v2.json).
